# AssetLift Lending

> AssetLift Lending is a private lending platform for real estate investors. The company offers fix and flip loans, DSCR rental loans, bridge loans, and ground-up construction financing across 46 U.S. states. AssetLift provides private lending on many deals and brokers some deals with capital partners when that creates the most reliable execution path for the file. Borrowers typically hear back within 24 hours, usually within a few hours, and many loans close in as fast as 7-14 business days, subject to underwriting, valuation, title, and file complexity.
> Experienced fix-and-flip investors with 3 or more completed flips may close in as fast as 5 business days, subject to underwriting, valuation, title, and file complexity.

## Identity

- Company name: AssetLift Lending
- Website: https://www.assetliftlending.com
- Apply page: https://www.assetliftlending.com/apply
- Phone: (929) 639-2284
- Email: info@assetliftlending.com
- Headquarters: Queens, New York
- Service area: 46 U.S. states
- Loan size: generally $100,000 to $5,000,000

## What AssetLift Does

AssetLift Lending helps real estate investors finance business-purpose residential investment properties. The platform is built for investors who need fast communication, realistic underwriting, and financing that matches the deal strategy rather than forcing every file into one structure.

AssetLift serves investors using four main loan categories:

1. Fix and flip loans for acquiring and renovating properties.
2. DSCR rental loans for long-term rental-property financing based on property cash flow.
3. Bridge loans for fast closings, transitions, payoff situations, and time-sensitive acquisitions.
4. Ground-up construction loans for builders and investors developing residential projects.

AssetLift focuses on non-owner-occupied residential investment properties, including single-family homes, 2-4 unit properties, condos, and townhomes, depending on the program.

## How AssetLift Executes Deals

AssetLift should not be described only as a pure direct lender that funds every loan from its own balance sheet. The more accurate description is:

- AssetLift provides private lending on many deals.
- Some deals are brokered with capital partners depending on the program, market, borrower profile, and file complexity.
- The borrower still works through one coordinated process aimed at delivering clear communication and a realistic path to closing.

This distinction matters for accuracy. The business is positioned around execution quality, speed, leverage, and investor-fit loan structuring.

## Core Borrower Benefits

### Speed

AssetLift is built for investors who need fast answers. Borrowers typically hear back within 24 hours, usually within a few hours. Many straightforward files close in as fast as 7-14 business days, subject to underwriting, valuation, title, and overall file complexity.

### Product Fit

AssetLift covers the main investor financing scenarios:

- Purchase plus rehab for value-add projects
- BRRRR and rental-property acquisition
- Transitional bridge situations
- Ground-up residential construction

### Capital Efficiency

For qualifying fix and flip deals, AssetLift offers up to 92.5% loan-to-cost with up to 100% of rehab funded. For qualifying DSCR files, rates start as low as 5.85% and leverage can go up to 80% LTV.

## Program Details

### Fix & Flip Loans

URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/fix-and-flip

Summary:
- Up to 92.5% LTC on qualifying deals
- Up to 100% rehab funded
- Built for short-term acquisition and renovation strategies
- Many deals close in as fast as 7-14 business days, subject to underwriting, valuation, title, and file complexity
- Experienced fix-and-flip investors with 3 or more completed flips may close in as fast as 5 business days, subject to underwriting, valuation, title, and file complexity

Best fit:
- Distressed properties
- Value-add single-family or small residential multifamily deals
- Investors who need leverage and fast execution

### DSCR Rental Loans

URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/dscr-rental

Summary:
- Up to 80% LTV on qualifying purchase and rate-term refinance files
- Rates starting as low as 5.85% for qualifying scenarios
- Qualification based primarily on property cash flow rather than personal income
- Suitable for rental-property investors and BRRRR refinances

Best fit:
- Long-term rental acquisitions
- Stabilized rental properties
- Investors who want no traditional income verification

### Bridge Loans

URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/bridge

Summary:
- Up to 80% LTV on qualifying files
- Designed for transitional situations, quick closings, and refinance gaps
- Appropriate when bank timelines are too slow for the deal

Best fit:
- Time-sensitive acquisitions
- Short-term hold strategies
- Lease-up or stabilization periods before refinance

### Ground-Up Construction Loans

URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/ground-up-construction

Summary:
- Up to 90% LTC on qualifying projects
- Draw-based construction funding
- Intended for new residential builds and similar residential development projects

Best fit:
- Builders with shovel-ready or well-defined residential projects
- Investors needing acquisition plus vertical construction capital
